title: From Clever Hans to Hypotheses: Interpreting EEG Foundational Transformers with LRP
abstract: arXiv:2605.11885v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Emerging foundation models (FMs) in electroencephalography (EEG) promise a path to scale deep learning in diagnostics and brain-computer interfaces despite data scarcity, yet their opaque nature remains a barrier to wider adoption. We investigate attention-aware Layer-wise relevance propagation (LRP) as a post-hoc attribution method for EEG-FMs, extending LRP's use on convolutional neural network (CNN)-based EEG models to the Transformer architectures that current FMs are based on. We find that LRP can both verify EEG-FM decisions and surface novel, biologically plausible hypotheses from them. In motor imagery, it unmasks 'Clever Hans' behavior where models prioritize task correlated ocular signals over the intended motor correlates. In a naturalistic paradigm for affect prediction, it reveals a recurring reliance on a central electrode cluster, suggesting a candidate sensorimotor signature of arousal. translated_title: 从“聪明汉斯”到科学假设：使用LRP解释脑电图基础模型Transformer
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.11885v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：脑电图（EEG）领域新兴的基础模型（FM）有望在数据稀缺的情况下，将深度学习扩展应用于诊断和脑机接口领域，但其不透明的特性仍是阻碍其广泛应用的壁垒。我们研究了注意力感知的逐层相关性传播（LRP）作为脑电图基础模型的事后归因方法，将LRP在基于卷积神经网络（CNN）的脑电图模型上的应用扩展到当前基础模型所依赖的Transformer架构。我们发现，LRP既能够验证脑电图基础模型的决策，又能从中挖掘出新颖且生物学上合理的假设。在运动想象任务中，它揭露了“聪明汉斯”行为，即模型优先依赖与任务相关的眼部信号，而非预期的运动相关信号。在一个用于情感预测的自然范式实验中，它揭示了模型反复依赖于一个中央电极簇，这提示了一种可能代表唤醒状态的感觉运动特征。尽管热图解释……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 该研究将注意力感知的逐层相关性传播（LRP）从事后归因方法扩展到基于Transformer架构的脑电图基础模型，既能验证模型决策，又能揭露“聪明汉斯”行为并生成生物学上合理的新神经科学假设。
en_tdlr: This work extends attention-aware Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) as a post-hoc attribution method to Transformer-based EEG foundation models, enabling both verification of model decisions and the discovery of novel, biologically plausible hypotheses, such as unmasking "Clever Hans" behavior in motor imagery.
